summary: Backend-only retest after routing fix. Updated TestPrivacyHtml in /app/backend/tests/test_avr_privacy.py to point at /api/privacy.html (public, inside /api prefix) instead of /privacy. Ran full privacy test suite + regression suite: 23/23 passed. Verified external URL https://nature-store-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api/privacy.html returns 200 text/html with 'Privacy Policy', 'AVR Organics', 'Last updated', 'support@herbalbloom.app' and all 9 required sections. JSON endpoint /api/privacy still 200 with keys last_updated, contact_email, contact_whatsapp, text. All previously green endpoints still work.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still exposes @app.get('/privacy') at top level — harmless internally but unreachable externally via K8s ingress. Safe to keep for internal/local dev; consider removing or documenting.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Bulk-import regression test creates and deletes p_TEST_privacy_regress within a single test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Privacy routing is fixed and verified. Submit https://nature-store-hub-1.emergent.host/api/privacy.html to Google Play Console. /api/privacy returns JSON; /api/privacy.html returns the HTML page. The internal-only /privacy route still exists as fallback for local dev.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration verified a routing fix; the previous iteration's /privacy failure root cause was that K8s ingress only forwards /api/* externally, so top-level /privacy returned the Expo app shell. Moving the HTML handler under api_router at /api/privacy.html resolves it.
